Information: Ph.D. Applied Coastal and Ocean Sciences
Complete applications are reviewed for admission by the program as they are received.
Program Contact
Dr. Nicole Fogarty
cms_education@uncw.edu
Location/Delivery Method
Main Campus
Recommendations
3 recommendations to be submitted through the online application with accompanying letters by individuals in professionally relevant fields, including those familiar with the student's performance in school.
Additional Requirements
PhD Research: Statement of PhD research interests (2 page maximum).
Research Thesis: Summary of M.S. thesis research (2 page maximum).
If you are applying with an undergraduate degree only, upload a document that simply states “No master’s thesis.”
Resume/CV: 2 page maximum
UNCW Faculty: Applicants should make initial contact with prospective faculty mentors prior to applying. Please contact the graduate program coordinator if you need assistance with this process.
